_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

910.name: Cradle of Humanity
910.label: Event
910.description: Ethiopia's Afar Triangle as one of the most important paleoanthropological sites on Earth; discovery of Australopithecus afarensis (Lucy) and other hominid fossils.

910.name: Lucy and Australopithecus afarensis
910.label: Event
910.description: Discovery of 'Lucy' (Dinkinesh) in Hadar 1974; 3.2-million-year-old Australopithecus afarensis; bipedalism evidence.

910.name: Omo and Herto: Earliest Homo sapiens
910.label: Event
910.description: Omo Kibish and Herto fossils — among oldest anatomically modern human remains; Ethiopia as origin point for Homo sapiens.

910.name: Ancient Ethiopian Civilisations
910.label: Event
910.description: From the Land of Punt through D'mt kingdom to the Aksumite Empire; one of Africa's greatest ancient civilisations.

910.name: Land of Punt Connections
910.label: Event
910.description: Ethiopian region as possible location of Punt; Egyptian trade expeditions for incense, gold, and exotic animals.

910.name: D'mt Kingdom
910.label: Event
910.description: Pre-Aksumite kingdom in northern Ethiopia/Eritrea; Yeha temple; Sabaean cultural influences; proto-Ge'ez inscriptions.

920.name: Zagwe and Solomonic Dynasties
920.label: Event
920.description: Zagwe dynasty and the rock-hewn churches of Lalibela; Solomonic dynasty restoration; medieval Ethiopian Christianity; Prester John legend.

920.name: Zagwe Dynasty and Lalibela Churches
920.label: Event
920.description: Zagwe dynasty rules from Roha (Lalibela); King Lalibela commissions eleven rock-hewn churches — 'New Jerusalem'; UNESCO World Heritage.

920.name: Solomonic Dynasty Restoration
920.label: Event
920.description: Yekuno Amlak restores Solomonic dynasty 1270; Kebra Nagast legitimises lineage; Zara Yaqob's centralisation and religious reforms.

930.name: Gondar Period and Era of Princes
930.label: Event
930.description: Gondar as capital; Fasilides' castles; Oromo expansion; Zemene Mesafint (Era of Princes) — decentralisation and warlordism.

930.name: Gondar and Fasilides' Castles
930.label: Event
930.description: Emperor Fasilides founds Gondar 1636; castle complex; Jesuit expulsion; brief cultural flourishing.

930.name: Oromo Expansion
930.label: Event
930.description: Massive Oromo migrations reshape Ethiopian demographics and politics; gadaa governance system; integration into imperial structures.

940.name: Modern Ethiopian Empire
940.label: Event
940.description: Tewodros II reunifies Ethiopia; Menelik II's expansion and Adwa victory; Haile Selassie's early reign and modernisation.

940.name: Tewodros II and Yohannes IV
940.label: Event
940.description: Tewodros II ends Era of Princes; modernisation attempts; British Expedition to Magdala 1868; Yohannes IV's consolidation and battles with Egypt and Mahdist Sudan.

940.name: Menelik II and the Battle of Adwa
940.label: Event
940.description: Menelik II expands Ethiopian borders; Treaty of Wuchale dispute; decisive victory at Battle of Adwa 1 March 1896 — Ethiopia remains unconquered.

950.name: Haile Selassie's Imperial Era
950.label: Event
950.description: Restoration of Haile Selassie; federation and annexation of Eritrea; founding of OAU in Addis Ababa; growing discontent.

950.name: Post-Liberation Restoration
950.label: Event
950.description: Haile Selassie restored; modernisation efforts; Addis Ababa as capital of OAU (founded 1963); federation with Eritrea 1952.

950.name: Ethiopian Revolution of 1974
950.label: Event
950.description: Wollo famine; student protests; military mutiny; Haile Selassie deposed 12 September 1974 by the Derg.

950.name: Derg Regime and Red Terror
950.label: Event
950.description: Mengistu Haile Mariam's Marxist military junta; Red Terror; Ogaden War; famine 1984; fall to EPRDF coalition.

950.name: Red Terror Campaign
950.label: Event
950.description: Mengistu's campaign of mass murder against political opponents; estimated tens of thousands killed; MEISON and EPRP targeted.

950.name: Ogaden War with Somalia
950.label: Event
950.description: Somalia invades Ogaden; Soviet and Cuban intervention saves Ethiopia; Cold War proxy conflict.

960.name: EPRDF Era, Abiy Ahmed, and the Tigray War
960.label: Event
960.description: Ethnic federalism under EPRDF; Meles Zenawi's development state; Abiy Ahmed's reforms and Nobel Peace Prize; Tigray War devastation.

960.name: EPRDF and Ethnic Federalism
960.label: Event
960.description: Meles Zenawi establishes ethnic federal system; developmental state model; TPLF dominance; contested elections 2005.

960.name: Meles Death and Transition
960.label: Event
960.description: Meles Zenawi dies 2012; Hailemariam Desalegn succeeds; Oromo and Amhara protests 2015-2018; state of emergency.
